description: List completed sales at the site in a date/time range — purchased items, payments and client. Read only. Mindbody: GET /sale/sales.

end_sale_date_time.description: Only sales before this date/time — ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T09:00:00.

offset.description: Page offset (request.offset). Mindbody defaults to 0. See PaginationResponse.TotalResults.

payment_method_id.description: Only sales paid with this payment method id.

start_sale_date_time.description: Only sales after this date/time — ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T09:00:00.

name: mindbody_list_sales
title: List sales
